content:
Priya (PM): quick check-in: i'm putting together a compact "GA readiness" checklist focused on operability and pricing floor. want to confirm owners and absolute no-go items before i lock.

Diego (Infra): +1. I can own autoscale smoke tests, canary traffic runner, and a baseline perf harness. FYI we still have the nvlink memory fragmentation flake for long sequences that we need to mark as tech-debt (not GA-blocking)

Rina (SRE): Owner for monitoring/runbooks. must-haves for me: synthetic canaries (latency + correctness), p99 tail alerts, and documented fallback to smaller model-variants. also need a documented regional failover drill scripted in CI.

Priya (PM): for SLAs, i'm proposing: Dedicated 99.9% monthly uptime, Hosted 99.5% (initial). Also propose latency guidance vs hard SLOs: publish p50/p95 targets per model family.

Ned (FinOps): pricing floor: we should publish a clear GA price sheet (hosted unit price, embedding unit price, reserved commit tiers). i need one week to finalize enterprise tier numbers. GA can ship with published floor + "enterprise pricing pending" note.

Diego (Infra): technical blockers: autoscale burst validation under synthetic burst > 1000 rps, and KV-cache cold-start path needs a regression test. i'll put up the smoke PR by tuesday.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPER-1987 (canary-runner) and OPER-1988 (regional-failover-drill), assigned Rina and Diego. :white_check_mark:

Priya (PM): Proposed minimal acceptance (respond with :thumbsup: to accept or call out blockers):
```
GA MINIMAL OPERABILITY CHECKPOINT (owners)
- SLA: Dedicated 99.9%, Hosted 99.5% (owner: Priya)
- Latency targets: publish p50/p95 by model family; engineering to aim p95 <= 200ms on small requests (owner: Diego)
- Monitoring: synthetic canaries + p99 latency/backpressure alerts (owner: Rina)
- Runbooks: SEV1/SEV2 + model-fallback playbook (owner: Rina)
- Autoscale & Failover: autoscale smoke harness + scripted regional failover CI job (owners: Diego/Rina)
- Docs: quickstart GA page, migration notes for pilots, operational expectations (owner: Priya)
- Support: business-hours triage + SEV1 on-call escalation path documented (owner: Priya)
- Pricing: published floor for GA + pending enterprise tiers (owner: Ned)
```

Rina (SRE): blocking items: regional failover automation + model-variant fallback under load must be tested. otherwise looks ok.

Diego (Infra): noted. i'll prioritize autoscale burst test. small ask: allow me to mark the nvlink flake as "deferred" with a mitigation note.

Ned (FinOps): i'll share draft price floor by friday. we should include example monthly commit scenarios to help sales.

Priya (PM): ok locking this as the shiproom operability checkpoint unless any hard blockers before EOD. thanks team.

Diego (Infra): :thumbsup:

Rina (SRE): :thumbsup: pending failover tickets.

Ned (FinOps): :thumbsup: (will follow up with numbers)
